test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All gifts are letters.

All letters are chats.

All words are gifts.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some chats are words.

II. All gifts are chats.

III. Some words are not letters.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All gifts are letters.

All letters are chats.

All words are gifts.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb24a17dbe2bada528f3ab93ea466751906f4cde361d54137b064ff38e508e11.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some chats are words - **True** (Because, all words are gifts, and all gifts are letters, and all letters are chats, so some chats are words).

II. All gifts are chats - **True** (Because, all gifts are letters, and all letters are chats, so all gifts are chats).

III. Some words are not letters - **False** (Because, all words are gifts, and all gifts are letters, so some words are not letters cannot be true).

So, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
